# What this is

A single cloneable workspace for applied papers that combine **survey design**, **IPTW**, **latent class analysis**, and **network analysis**, with a fill-in-the-blanks reporting skeleton. Every new paper starts from the same structure, so coauthors spend time on the science, not on re-scaffolding.

## The four method modules

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Survey design

Build a survey design object (weights, strata, PSU), check the weights, and carry the design through every downstream estimate. See [Survey design](guide/survey-design.qmd).

### IPTW

Estimate propensity scores, construct inverse-probability-of-treatment weights, diagnose covariate balance, and estimate treatment effects. See [IPTW](guide/iptw.qmd).

### Latent class analysis

Fit and compare LCA models across class counts, pick the best fit by information criteria, and assign respondents to classes. See [Latent class analysis](guide/lca.qmd).

### Network analysis

Turn an edge list or adjacency matrix into an `igraph` object, compute centrality and communities, and visualize the network. See [Network analysis](guide/network.qmd).

:::

## How to use this template

1. [Set up](guide/setup.qmd) R, Quarto, and the project library.
2. Understand the [repository structure](guide/structure.qmd).
3. [Start a new paper](guide/start-a-paper.qmd) from the template.
4. Run the numbered pipeline in `analysis/`.
5. Fill in `paper/paper.qmd` and render.

The live guide you are reading is itself generated from this repo. The source lives at [connectors-testing-pplx/research-paper-template](https://github.com/connectors-testing-pplx/research-paper-template).
